symptom_signature: web_on=1 in ini and /api/* answers 200, but http://localhost:8090/ and all static files return 404 (dashboard 'enabled in settings, dead in reality')
probe: probe / + /api/regs on :8090; compare the host process launch cwd with the exe dir
likely_cause: bare WebApplication.CreateBuilder takes ContentRoot = CURRENT WORKING DIRECTORY — launching the host from any cwd other than the exe dir (Start-Process, script, shortcut) relocates WebRoot away from the deployed wwwroot ⇒ API (explicitly mapped) works, static 404
remediation: ContentRootPath pinned to AppContext.BaseDirectory in BOTH hosts (tray StartWeb + shell ShellHost) — wwwroot deploys next to the exe; never rely on launch cwd

symptom_signature: legacy tray menu item «Панель (WinUI)» permanently gray (Enabled=false)
probe: recompute WinUiShellPath logic: Path.GetDirectoryName(AppContext.BaseDirectory-with-trailing-slash) strips ONLY the separator
likely_cause: fixed-depth 4-step directory walk from a trailing-slash BaseDirectory lands in iCemDataMonitor.Tray instead of server-dotnet ⇒ shell exe never found ⇒ menu item disabled since W9
remediation: never do fixed-depth directory walks from BaseDirectory: trim trailing separators AND walk up until the target file exists (upward search, depth-proof) — fixed in WinUiShellPath + reused for EmuleExePath

symptom_signature: iCemEmule.exe does not start by itself although emule_on=1 was set in station.ini
probe: Get-Process iCemEmule; read startup.log of the RUNNING host for an 'iCemEmule started/reusing/not found' line; check WHICH station.ini the host reads = AppContext.BaseDirectory\\station.ini (next to the exe), NOT server-dotnet\\station.ini
likely_cause: (1) emule code existed ONLY in the WinUI shell (fixed W11.8: legacy tray also supervises); (2) the per-exe ini lacks emule_on=1 — the fail-safe Save emits the key with the in-memory default 0 on ANY toggle-save, silently overwriting operator expectations; (3) an engine already running (manual launch) is REUSED, not adopted — no 'started' line, by design
remediation: set emule_on=1 in the ini NEXT TO THE HOST EXE (shell bin OR tray bin — they are different files); restart the host; verify parent PID of iCemEmule == host PID

symptom_signature: iCemDataMonitor.WinUI.exe runs (Task Manager) but NO tray icon anywhere; closing the window leaves an invisible zombie (close-to-tray by design, tray unreachable)
probe: read startup.log for 'tray icon created: True/False'; enumerate NotifyIconOverflowWindow toolbar buttons
likely_cause: code-only H.NotifyIcon TaskbarIcon: the Win32 icon is created ONLY in FrameworkElement.Loaded — an element never added to a visual tree never fires Loaded ⇒ Shell_NotifyIcon never called (library design, verified in H.NotifyIcon master source TaskbarIcon.cs ctor)
remediation: TrayIconHost must call _icon.ForceCreate(enablesEfficiencyMode:false) — efficiency mode (EcoQoS) forbidden for the in-proc service host; new icons land in the overflow chevron by OS policy (pin via Settings > Taskbar > Select which icons appear)

symptom_signature: tray process exists but no tray icon; startup.log stops mid-sequence
likely_cause: second instance exited silently OR fatal before tray icon (zombie pattern)
remediation: read startup.log violations; kill old instance holding Global\iCemDataMonitorTray_v1; restart

symptom_signature: Modbus FC03 on :502 returns all zeros across every range
likely_cause: bus file DACL lacks BUILTIN\Users:Modify (created by elevated/foreign context); ReadWrite view denied; POC writer disabled; AddIn writes missing
remediation: delete Data.dat (recreated with Users:Modify) OR grant Modify; restart ALL station processes incl. iCem.exe

symptom_signature: BusAccessDeniedException: LIVE named section capacity is SMALLER than this process requires
probe: Get-Item C:\ProgramData\Halliburton\iCem\DataMonitoring\Data.dat | Select-Object Length; read Required bytes in exception text
likely_cause: capacity skew: live section held at a legacy size (e.g. 1364 v2) by a producer until every handle closes; file already expanded to 20066
remediation: stop ALL station processes incl. iCem.exe; start producer AddIn FIRST, then POC

symptom_signature: BusAccessDeniedException: ACCESS DENIED - bus file cannot be opened for ReadWrite mapping (ACL wording, not capacity)
likely_cause: file DACL installed by different security context denies this process ReadWrite
remediation: delete file (recreated with corrected ACL) OR BUILTIN\Users:(M); restart required (section keeps old ACL until all handles close)

symptom_signature: lan_stream_crio words alternate correct [AE 14 3F A7] with truncated [00 14 00 A7] (high byte of every word zeroed, low byte survives)
probe: icemdatamonitor-cli snapshot; poll reg 200..399; highByte==0x00 and lowByte!=0x00 = signature
likely_cause: byte-width truncation in the AddIn lan_stream_crio write path (1.6.1: AddIn primary writer ∧ POC LanBusSink V6 decoded cRIO signals — truncation signature ⇒ AddIn defect; POC byte law pinned by BusWriteTruthTableTests)
remediation: BusWriteTruthTableTests prove POC byte law; fix AddIn dll write path (sources C:\Users\HALLIBURTON\iCemPOC\Burservis.iCem.DataMonitor)

probe: icemdatamonitor-cli header; sample reg 3 twice 2 s apart
likely_cause: iCem.exe or AddIn dll dead (reg3 +1/s ALWAYS while AddIn loaded = pipeline-alive; frozen ⇔ iCem/AddIn dead, NOT ⇔ ¬Streaming)
remediation: start iCem.exe with AddIn loaded; never auto-start/kill iCem (operator app); check POC is reading

symptom_signature: AceSnifferService logs watchdog restart in 5s repeatedly
probe: check templates/lantable_registry.json exists; verify Npcap; check AceSniffer:Adapter setting
likely_cause: configured adapter missing or Npcap unavailable (manual adapter config only)
remediation: set AceSniffer:Adapter to the 82574L NIC name; install/repair Npcap

symptom_signature: Modbus :502 bind fails after 5x5s; FATAL in startup.log
likely_cause: port held by previous instance (TIME_WAIT) or third-party SCADA
remediation: identify holder by PID; stop it; restart iCemDataMonitor.Tray

symptom_signature: icemdatamonitor-cli get lan_ext returns [] while lan zone is active
probe: icemdatamonitor-cli snapshot | measure length; check ini total=
likely_cause: smaller dictionary file (650/1650 regs) loaded; lan_ext tail not addressable; bounds-guarded decode yields empty
remediation: fix station.ini total=10001; ordered restart: producer first to expand bus file

symptom_signature: ace_full reserve 600..10000 holds non-zero values but no writer is active
likely_cause: external FC06/FC16 writes persist by design; ace_full DEFERRED in v5 (nobody writes; layout designed later)
remediation: no remediation; reserved zone; do not map registry entries there until ace_full lands

symptom_signature: lan_stream_crio 200..399 never mirrors on Modbus while AddIn loaded
probe: icemdatamonitor-cli snapshot; check lan_stream_crio activeFlag @ header 0x1B(27)
likely_cause: Lan liveness block (tick@0x13(19), flag@0x1B(27), counter@0x29(41)) must be marked by the AddIn for lan_stream_crio; if the deployed dll revision does not mark the Lan block the block stays 0 ⇒ A4 hold ⇒ zone not mirrored
remediation: update AddIn dll to a revision that marks the Lan block per lan batch; restart iCem.exe

symptom_signature: Modbus :502 all zeros while icemdatamonitor-cli reads the SAME bus fine (header OK, heartbeat advancing); startup.log: '8% Bus mapping...' then no bus verdict
probe: compare tray bin DLL LastWriteTime vs source build time (deployment skew check); read startup.log 'bus open OK/FAILED' line; probe the DEPLOYED iCemDataMonitor.Sdk.dll IsValidShape against the live file
likely_cause: publisher stuck in bus-absent: the reader shape gate rejects the bus file every tick (stale binaries vs upgraded v5 bus); stale-hold doctrine degrades SILENTLY on stale builds (tick-loop catch swallowed the fail-safe error)
remediation: rebuild + redeploy the tray (consumer — restart freely, iCem untouched); align station.ini zones to v5 (total=10001); builds pin the failure via Publisher.LastBusError + startup.log verdict + ModbusContractTests OpenFail_*

symptom_signature: live gate blk200/blk300 static (mirror OK, values nonzero-but-frozen); AddIn marks lan liveness (writeCount advancing, age <1 s)
probe: 10 s wire capture on the 82574L (ace-like frames present?); Emu emule_config.xml LanEnabled (MASTER) vs LanEmuleEnabled; SUSTAINED value change in 200..399 via icemdatamonitor-cli (two samples apart) as the primary signal; bus reg 2 caseLanState IS reactive (2→4 with LAN acquisition, operator-verified) — usable as a hint, but the tap-exposed enum semantics is AddIn-version-specific, so the gate diagnoses by value-change only
likely_cause: (1) Emu master switch LanEnabled=false — the emitter opens ONLY on LanEnabled (TrayApp auto-start + LanTab.OnEnableChanged); LanEmuleEnabled alone = silent channel, AddIn rewrites last-known values; (2) iCem LAN acquisition not started after an iCem restart (manual UI step; the link does NOT auto-recover after an emitter swap)
remediation: set LanEnabled=true + restart the Emu (the gate patches both flags); verify ace frames on the wire first; then start LAN telemetry acquisition in the iCem UI (operator app — the gate never touches it)

symptom_signature: Deployed emule\ui shows OLD XAML after a rebuild (page layout/tokens stale)
probe: compare LastWriteTime of deployed iCemDataMonitor.Emulator.WinUI.dll vs iCemEmule.WinUI\bin\x64\Debug output
likely_cause: DeployEmuleEngine copied from iCemEmule.WinUI\bin\Debug\... but the MSBuild task builds with Platform=x64 => output lands in bin\x64\Debug\...; two divergent output roots, deploy consumed the stale one
remediation: _EmuleUiOutput path fixed to bin\x64\$(Configuration)\... in iCemDataMonitor.Tray.csproj and iCemDataMonitor.Shell.WinUI.csproj; delete stale bin\Debug
